grounded_finding: PTGER4 mixed shared/distinct signal closes naive transfer
do_not_reopen_for: General MS/IBD transfer-caution literature, pathway summaries, or broad target lists.
reopen_only_if: PTGER4-specific fine-mapping, QTL, or treatment-transfer data with direction and disease-layer definitions that directly address the mixed-signal failure mode.
why: General treatment-transfer caution is context only; the project already closed naive transfer for this signal.

grounded_finding: No validated broad immune-state simulator from held data
do_not_reopen_for: Curated MS gene/resource databases, simulator enthusiasm, or perturbation-resource metadata.
reopen_only_if: A held-out perturbation or response dataset plus a frozen split suitable for simulator validation.
why: Resource metadata cannot repair the held-out simulator validation failure.

grounded_finding: Coupled-axis successor rule does not beat scalar
do_not_reopen_for: Treatment labels, mechanism summaries, or in-sample coupled-axis performance.
reopen_only_if: A preregistered external scalar-versus-successor comparison using the immutable V22 scalar and any pre-locked successor under V27/V42-style rules.
why: The current project result is negative-established; a treatment label cannot evaluate predictive superiority.

grounded_finding: Locked V7 general cross-disease baseline fallback killed
do_not_reopen_for: Generic prediction-model guidance or broad cross-disease plausibility arguments.
reopen_only_if: A predefined external dataset directly matching the cross-disease baseline-fallback rule and failure-mode comparison.
why: General validation guidance supports caution but does not test the specific killed rule.

grounded_finding: RA pregnancy comparator but blood APC treatment-response nontransfer
reopen_only_if: Paired MS/RA treatment-response transfer data, not pregnancy timing data alone.
why: Pregnancy transcriptomes can inform timing hypotheses but do not test blood APC treatment-response transfer.

do_not_reopen_for: External nomination of GPR25 as a putative gene or broad locus listing.
reopen_only_if: GPR25-specific direction, QTL, fine-mapping, and tractability evidence that resolves the V19 demotion reason.
why: A putative-gene nomination is not direction-matched target evidence.

grounded_finding: No load-bearing invariant found in V26
do_not_reopen_for: General biomarker heterogeneity context or claims that invariants are biologically plausible.
reopen_only_if: A predefined invariant candidate with cross-modality data sufficient for null/permutation testing.
why: General heterogeneity context is not an invariant-search replication.
